name: Ken to Butter ~Kateba Love Love Makereba Ryoujoku~
original_name: 剣とバター ～勝てばラブラブ負ければ陵辱～
source:
A post warring era world where bandits roam the lands.
In order to protect their village the heroines create self defense corps.
But can these girls actually protect themselves?
